text:
Marta (CSM): Heads up — Greenscape QBR prep. They hit a big spike in embeddings last week, renewal in 28 days. Need token burn forecast + mitigation options. Can whoever owns spend forecast take this?

Raj (FinOps): On it. Pulling usage now. rough numbers: 3.2M embedding tokens/day peak, 450k gen tokens/day. Their monthly commit is 18M tokens.

Raj (FinOps): Dashboard -> https://rdw.in/console/accounts/greenscape/usage (shared temp link)

OpsBot: :warning: alert: account Greenscape crossed 75% of monthly commit (threshold: 75%) — 2025-11-03T09:13Z

Emil (Solutions Eng): For embeddings, recommend switch to emb-small for low-quality vectors + prefix caching. We saw ~40% cost drop on similar accounts.

Emil (Solutions Eng): Also suggest a soft-rate-limit policy on embed.route (burst=50 req/s) and 10s per-client KV cache TTL.

Ana (SE): I can run a 30m enablement session with their infra lead and capture feedback. Will prepare a short playbook.

Marta (CSM): Can Raj post a 90/60/30 day spend forecast? Need runway and renewal risk (green/yellow/red).

Raj (FinOps): Dropping quick forecast (rough):
```
30d forecast: 96M tokens (~$7.2k projected)
60d forecast: 210M tokens (~$15.7k projected)
90d forecast: 360M tokens (~$27k projected)
Recommendation: propose uplift to reserved capacity or add temporary credit buffer of $10k.
Risk: High without throttling — renewal = at-risk
```

Marta (CSM): Assign owners: Raj -> forecast & billing proposal; Emil -> config & throttles; Ana -> enablement session; I will own renewal outreach. Sync in 10:30 PT? :calendar: :thumbsup:

Emil (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet for soft-rate-limit to drop in console:
```
routes:
  - name: embed.route
    policy:
      type: soft_limit
      params:
        burst: 50
        sustained: 20
        fallback: emb-small
```

Ana (SE): I'll prepare the feedback doc and send the invite. Template link: https://rdw.in/templates/enablement-feedback

Marta (CSM): Also capture business-impact bullets for the QBR slide (search latency spikes, ingestion paused twice during peak).

Raj (FinOps): Noted. I'll add a slide with burn vs commit and suggested reserved tiers. If throttling doesn't reduce burn to <90% of commit, I'll flag for urgent renewal intervention.

OpsBot: :information_source: deploybot: canary config updates scheduled for embed.route at 10:55 PT — owner: Emil.

Marta (CSM): Meeting invite sent for 10:30 PT. If anything changes, ping me or @here.

Emil (Solutions Eng): I'll push the soft-limit canary and monitor token delta post-deploy.

Ana (SE): I'll capture feature asks in the feedback doc and share before the QBR.

Raj (FinOps): Final ask — anyone with recent similar accounts, drop one-liners on what worked (pricing, cache, smaller embed models).
